measured_problem: Removing complete heads is inefficient: 26 of 32 exact source heads are needed for 0.98 train reconstruction, costing 30.67M projection multiply-adds at layer 1 while still missing held-out RMSE. In contrast, the prior global rank-384 attention-delta oracle nearly passes, indicating broad head-pattern diversity but compressible value/output channel structure.
proposed_representation: Preserve all 32 exact source Q/K attention patterns, but factor each head's composed value/output operator O_h times V_h through a smaller internal rank. Compute each rank-96 operator's exact SVD using two reduced QR decompositions and a 96x96 core SVD. Allocate at least one component to every head, then pool the remaining source-weight singular energies and select the minimum total internal rank reaching 0.98 operator energy. Evaluate only that one derived variable per-head rank schedule with exact Q/K patterns and factored V/O paths.
portability_if_feasible: A later LayerCake-native operator would copy selected Q/K row slices and only the factored V/O tensors for every head, retaining distinct attention patterns without a complete source block, full V/O projections, unselected singular components, the source model object, or teacher inference at deployment.
decision: Authorize exactly one separately preregistered within-head V/O factorization oracle. A held-out pass plus exact factorization integrity and strict total-rank compression authorizes an installable LayerCake sparse-head operator and physical runtime screen. A miss closes source-weight-only within-head V/O factorization without energy, allocation, weighting, Q/K, data, source, or gate variants.
claim_boundary: Architecture review only; no factor schedule, copied weights, model, autonomous quality, physical runtime, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
